Vendor: Lichtlaerm Audio Thorn | Amenra Signature Distortion $269.00 Variant Variant: Cult FX Silver / Black / Red Cult FX Silver / Black / Red Lichtlaerm Gold / Black Etched Alu 1st Edition Product variants Cult FX Silver / Black / Red - $269.00 Lichtlaerm Gold / Black - Sold Out - $269.00 Etched Alu 1st Edition - Sold Out - $269.00 Add to cart     Pairs well with A collaboration that was meant to be: Lichtlaerm Audio and Lennart Bossu of Amenra (as well as Oathbreaker and Living Gate) conspired to create Lennart’s signature distortion pedal: Thorn. It’s based on the elusive providence stampede, but tweaked and taken to the next level from there. Whether you want to go for the classic SDT-1 or SDT-2 sounds, or the more contemporary "Laerm" setting, the Thorn delivers massive and organic post metal grit with unrivaled transparency.
